problem.name: Equality in simultaneous-message communication
problem.statement_latex: Alice receives $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ and Bob receives $y\in\{0,1\}^n$. Each sends one message to a referee deciding $x=y$ with error at most $1/3$. The senders have independent private randomness and no shared random key or prior entanglement. Complexity counts transmitted bits or qubits.

strength.description_latex: $\Theta(\sqrt n/\log n)$ reduction in communication, conventionally called an exponential separation in message length.

quantum.headline_latex: $\Theta(\log n)$ qubits by quantum fingerprinting. An error-correcting code maps inputs to quantum states; the referee uses a SWAP test. Error $\delta$ costs $O(\log n\log(1/\delta))$ qubits.
